subject: Finlytics eval kickoff \n\nnext steps & scheduling
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sana Riaz <sana@finlytics.com>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@finlytics.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 05 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Finlytics eval kickoff — next steps & scheduling

Hi Sana/Tom,

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciate the thoughtful run-through of your current stack and the goals for this project. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

1) Goals we heard:
- Reduce per-request latency for batch scoring of financial documents (90th perc target < 400ms)
- Lower per-token inference cost for embeddings-driven rerank by ~30%
- Maintain comparable quality to your current baseline on your prompt set

2) Success criteria (for the eval):
- 90th-percentile latency under 400ms on a 2k token sequence for the top endpoint
- Embedding similarity recall within 2% of current prod on the evaluation prompt set
- End-to-end throughput to support your peak batch windows 

3) Proposed trial plan (high level):
- 2-week evaluation window with: dedicated capacity for throughput testing, a prompt set for quality checks, and a defined set of traffic patterns to run.
- We'll run automated evals against your prompt set and provide weekly dashboards and token-level cost breakdowns.

Next step: schedule the 60-minute kickoff (technical deep dive + trial planning). Our ask is to get engineering and ML folks on the call so we can scope data access, prompt sets, and success metrics. Proposed times (PT):
- Wed, Feb 10, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu, Feb 11, 15:00–16:00 PT

Please confirm a preferred slot and who will attend (we suggest including your ML lead + SRE). I attached a short proposed eval plan for reference.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Attachment: Finlytics-proposed-eval-plan.pdf
